caveats: Reddit could not be sampled at all (reddit.com blocked for both fetch and search), so 'users.mentions' rely on Hacker News, Blender Artists and Godot Forum; counts are smaller than the 5-10 target for Rodin and Sloyd. G2 and Capterra were not reachable (403/no listing); Meshy's G2 4.7 is unverified. All3DP pages returned 403 (recorded as verified:false). YouTube comparison videos were verified (title, channel, date, chapter timestamps via page metadata) but transcripts could not be retrieved, so their verdicts are NOT recorded and they are listed as examples, not rated reviews. No truly independent, multi-input, multi-tool editorial test of current versions (Tripo 3.1 / Meshy 7.x / Rodin Gen-2.5) was found from CG/game-dev outlets (80.lv, CG Channel, Game Developer, Creative Bloq, TechRadar); the closest are StraySpark (April 2026, older versions), 3Dnatives (Meshy only, printing focus), and non-independent Fuser and HackerNoon (Meshy employee) tests. top3d.ai is the only arena with current commercial Tripo/Rodin; its operator is a YouTube creator who sells ad placements, and independence could not be fully established. Meshy's '63.8% preferred over Tripo 3.1' claim was seen only via search summaries; the fetched /compare page described internal geometry metrics instead. Version drift is large: evidence ranges from Meshy-4/Rodin v1.5 (2025) to Meshy 7.1/Tripo P2 (Oct 2026).
